title: Pelion Machine Learning platform
summary: Cloud and web application services supporting embedded-device machine-learning workflows.

dates.note: Within the April 2020–April 2023 role; exact project dates are unspecified. A September 2020 document records implementation.

facts.text: The platform enabled data scientists to design embedded-device models in Jupyter and remotely flash models as Mbed OS applications through Pelion Device Management.
Implemented backend functionality for users to start and stop Jupyter notebooks from a frontend dashboard.
Created an end-to-end system-testing framework for the Pelion Machine Learning platform.
Defined and implemented the PostgreSQL database schema.
Implemented React JavaScript and CSS dashboard components and configured Auth0 user authentication.

notes: Platform context does not establish authorship of model research, training algorithms, or the entire model-deployment pipeline. No adoption or scale metric is supplied.
